facts.timeout: A missing request and a missing acknowledgement need different continuations.
facts.neither: Stale absence, non-idempotent replay, expiring holds and opaque observations require expanded state.
facts.fence: A tested present/absent fence can discriminate without repeating an effect.
facts.delay: A tested bounded wait can qualify a stale query within its measured delay.
facts.compensation: Cancellation on an empty token is not evidence that an existing effect is compensable.
facts.composition: Single-provider completion does not imply safe complementary bundle completion.
facts.scope: Finite synthetic interface; conformance probes do not certify arbitrary providers.
facts.clock_phase: Reset-phase replay evidence does not qualify an unknown successor global-clock phase or epoch boundary; qualify the intended interval or choose another resolver.
